rucio._comment_pfn_sample_count: null = fetch every child file's PFNs (one /replicas/list request per dataset). Set an integer N to fetch only N files per dataset (much faster).
rucio._comment_metadata_batch_size: DIDs per /dids/bulkmeta request; also the flush/resume checkpoint unit. null sends everything in one request (no incremental progress or resume).
rucio._comment_scope_regex: Default filter for --all-scopes, e.g. '^(winter|spring|summer)\\d{4}$'. null = process every discovered scope.
rucio._comment_fetch_rules: Fetch replication rules per DID and from parent containers (a rule may live on the container while replicas report on the dataset). Enabling this also enables fetch_parents.
rucio._comment_embed_file_replicas: true = per-file LFN/PFN rows nested under each dataset as 'file_replicas' (single output file). false = written to a separate <scope>_dataset_file_replicas.ndjson.
rucio._comment: Endpoint and auth. token_env is checked before token_file.

vocabulary._comment: Naming vocabulary. Source: HEP-FCC/EventProducer common/printer.py. Editable without touching Python.
vocabulary._comment_extension_map: Fallback when no stage token appears in the path. Ordered longest-suffix-first.
vocabulary._comment_bookkeeping: Child files with these suffixes are job bookkeeping, not physics data; a dataset with only such children gets file-type null.
vocabulary._comment_accelerator: Campaign -> accelerator lookup. Unlisted campaigns yield null, never a silent default.
vocabulary._comment_detector_aliases: Exact-match canonicalisation. Do not case-fold blindly: variant detector names must survive intact.

layouts._comment: DID path layouts, evaluated in order; first match wins. 'stage_token_at' is the segment index holding a stage token (null = none). 'fields' maps navigation fields to segment indices.

granularity._comment: 'did' = one entity per Rucio DATASET; 'process' = collapse on process_key. The upsert UUID includes navigation values, so changing mode after a production import orphans existing rows instead of updating them. Decide before first import.

output._comment: Strict whitelist: metadata keys not listed are dropped from the converted output. Whitelist rather than blacklist so schema upgrades cannot silently admit new fields.
output._comment_indent: JSON indent for converted output. null = compact single line.
output._comment_exclude_layouts: Layouts skipped at conversion. Excluded entities are counted and listed on stderr each run, never silently dropped. [] to include everything.
